title: This cat memecoin has paid holders $2.8 million in Zcash as ZEC tops $1,200
summary: A brand new ZCAT token charges a 3% tax whenever the token moves and uses the proceeds to distribute ZEC to holders, creating an unusual link to one of crypto's hottest assets.
content: A newly launched cat memecoin has distributed $2.8 million in Zcash to its token holders. The ZCAT token implements a 3 percent transfer tax, using the collected proceeds to reward holders with ZEC. This mechanism links the memecoin directly to the privacy-focused cryptocurrency as its market price surges past $1,200.

summary:

The post Goldman Strategist Holds 12,000 KOSPI Target: Will Memory Earnings Close a 74% Gap? appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: Goldman Sachs chief Asia Pacific equity strategist Timothy Moe is maintaining a 12,000 target for South Korea's KOSPI index. The ambitious target would require the index to climb roughly 74 percent from its current level. Moe originally published the call three months ago before the market dropped a quarter of its value, and he has not revised his forecast.
